value.description: The value to write, in engineering units: true or false for a binary point, a whole number from 1 for a multi-state one, a number within the point's limits otherwise. null releases a BACnet point's priority slot.

title: Command
description: Sent to site/building/device/point/$set, live (never retained), to a point whose $meta says writable. Exactly {"value": …}: anything else is rejected as invalid-payload. MQTT 5 correlation data is echoed on the result, and a message expiry shortens how long the command may wait.
